title: Spectral Condition for $\mu$P under Width-Depth Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2603.00541v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative foundation models are increasingly scaled in both width and depth, posing significant challenges for stable feature learning and reliable hyperparameter (HP) transfer across model sizes. While maximal update parameterization~($\mu$P) has provided a principled solution to both problems for width scaling, existing extensions to the joint width-depth scaling regime remain fragmented, architecture- and optimizer-specific, and often rely on technically involved theories. In this work, we develop a simple and unified spectral framework for $\mu$P under joint width-depth scaling. For deep residual networks whose residual blocks contain $k$ transformations, the framework specifies how the norms of weights and their per-step updates should scale with width and depth. translated_title: 宽度-深度缩放下μP的谱条件
translated_abstract: 生成式基础模型在宽度和深度两个维度上不断扩展，这为稳定特征学习以及跨模型规模的可靠超参数迁移带来了重大挑战。虽然最大更新参数化（μP）已为宽度缩放下的这两个问题提供了有原则的解决方案，但现有针对宽度-深度联合缩放机制的扩展仍然碎片化、依赖于特定架构和优化器，且往往依赖技术上复杂的理论。在本工作中，我们为宽度-深度联合缩放下的μP开发了一个简单而统一的谱框架。对于残差块包含k个变换的深度残差网络，该框架规定了权重范数及其每步更新应如何随宽度和深度进行缩放。它揭示了从k=1到k≥2之间的基本转变，统一了先前各不相同、彼此割裂的μP表述，并确定了CompleteP风格的参数化（……
tldr: 本工作提出了一个简单统一的谱框架来刻画宽度-深度联合缩放下的μP，揭示了残差块中变换数量从k=1到k≥2的基本转变，从而统一了先前分散的μP理论并确立了CompleteP式参数化的地位。
en_tdlr: This work develops a simple and unified spectral framework for μP under joint width-depth scaling, revealing a fundamental transition from k=1 to k≥2 residual transformations that unifies previously disparate μP formulations and identifies the CompleteP-style parameterization.
